register.labelZh: REACH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: reach out 可以表示主動聯絡某人或機構;reach out for help 則可以表示尋求協助。；reach into、reach over、reach back、reach across、reach through 和 reach towards 可以清楚說明手或手臂移動的方向。；這些表達可用於說明如何拿取物件、按下按鈕、打開東西或幫助別人。；reach for 強調想要觸碰或拿取的物件;其他 REACH 表達則說明伸手的路線或方向。
register.summaryEn: Reach out can describe contacting a person or organisation, while reach out for help can describe asking for support. Reach into, reach over, reach back, reach across, reach through and reach towards show clearly where a hand or arm moves. These expressions are useful when explaining how to take an object, press a button, open something or help another person. Reach for focuses on the object a person wants to touch or take. Other REACH expressions show the route or direction of the movement.
